info.title: Billu Bazaar Mobile Customer API
info.description: Customer APIs organized by feature. Log in with the existing mobile Auth API and use its token in Authorize. All feature routes require customer authentication.

bearerAuth.description: Mobile access token returned by /mob-api/auth/login or /register. Paste without the Bearer prefix.

post.description: Registers a new customer account, enforces unique email and unique phone number, awards loyalty bonus points, and returns a 10-year access token.

message.example: Customer registered successfully

400.description: Validation failure (missing field / invalid email / weak password / invalid phone)

message.example: Please enter a valid email address

409.description: Conflict — Email or Phone number already registered

message.example: This phone number is already registered
Internal server error

post.description: Authenticates customer by email and password, returning a 10-year access token embedded with customer profile and cartCount.

200.description: Login successful

message.example: Login successful
Email and password are required

401.description: Incorrect password

message.example: Incorrect password
Your account has been deactivated. Please contact customer support.

404.description: No account found with this email address

message.example: No account found with this email address

post.description: Generates a 6-digit OTP code valid for 10 minutes and emails it to the customer.

200.description: OTP code emailed successfully

message.example: A 6-digit verification code has been sent to your email
Please enter a valid email address

404.description: Email not registered

message.example: No account found with this email address

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP code against the hashed token and issues a short-lived resetToken for setting a new password.

200.description: OTP verified successfully

message.example: OTP verified successfully

400.description: Invalid OTP / expired OTP / no active OTP

message.example: Invalid OTP. Please check the code and try again.

404.description: Account not found

message.example: No account found with this email address

post.description: Updates customer password using the verified resetToken.

200.description: Password updated successfully

message.example: Password has been updated successfully. You can now login.

400.description: Missing resetToken or password too short

message.example: Password must be at least 6 characters long

401.description: Password reset session expired or invalid

message.example: Password reset session has expired or is invalid. Please restart the process.

404.description: Account not found or deactivated

message.example: Account not found or deactivated
